progress_criterion.statement: The next advance must use the actual positive exponential curve with complete beta-anchor, range, and multiplicity labels to force normalized eligible divisor-moment gain, or build a countermodel satisfying those genuine constraints. A signed abstract model, source-marginal calculation, compatibility calculus, direct edge, web count, finite lift example, scalar gcd average, unanchored recurrence, beta-free packet, or deduplicated plane count alone is non-progress.
